title: VISUAL SCHEMA — THE PARABLE OF LEE SHARKS & MARY LEE
creator: not declared
description:
An undeclared-author visual-schema specification for **INDEX ≠ OCEAN**, a diagrammatic rendering of the Parable of Lee Sharks and Mary Lee.

The proposed image is a vertical cross-section with three zones: an index-and-signal surface, a confusion band of overlapping labels and authority-weighted substitution, and deep untracked space containing distinct but adjacent shark and writer presences. The governing distinctions are index is not existence, tag is not life, signal is not meaning, and absence of tracking is not proof of nonexistence. The schema is intended to teach disambiguation and provenance through visual topology; it is not a factual claim that the untracked shark survived, a completed image, or an empirical marine-science record.
